import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static Room[][] floorplan = new Room[10][10];

    static class Room {
        int i, j;
        boolean[] infected = new boolean[61];
        boolean[] accessible = new boolean[61];
        int scientists, capsules;

        Room() {
            scientists = 0;
            capsules = 0;
            Arrays.fill(infected, false);
            Arrays.fill(accessible, true);
        }

        int getNodeId(int timestamp) {
            return 2 + i + n * j + (n * n) * timestamp;
        }

        void setReactor() {
            Arrays.fill(accessible, false);
        }

        void setInfected(int timestamp) {
            if (accessible[timestamp]) {
                accessible[timestamp] = false;
                infected[timestamp] = true;
            }
        }

        void spreadInfection(int timestamp) {
            if (infected[timestamp]) {
                setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (i > 0) floorplan[i - 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (i < n - 1) floorplan[i + 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (j > 0) floorplan[i][j - 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (j < n - 1) floorplan[i][j + 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    static class ScalingMaxFlow {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev, cap;
            Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
            }
        }

        int N;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> g;

        ScalingMaxFlow(int n) {
            N = n;
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int v, int to, int cap) {
            Edge a = new Edge(to, g.get(to).size(), cap);
            Edge b = new Edge(v, g.get(v).size(), 0);
            g.get(v).add(a);
            g.get(to).add(b);
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t, int delta, int[] parentNode, int[] parentEdge) {
            Arrays.fill(parentNode, -1);
            Arrays.fill(parentEdge, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            parentNode[s] = s;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int i = 0; i < g.get(v).size(); i++) {
                    Edge e = g.get(v).get(i);
                    if (e.cap >= delta && parentNode[e.to] == -1) {
                        parentNode[e.to] = v;
                        parentEdge[e.to] = i;
                        if (e.to == t) return true;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return parentNode[t] != -1;
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int total = 0;
            int biggest = 0;
            for (Edge e : g.get(s)) {
                biggest = Math.max(biggest, e.cap);
            }
            int delta = 1;
            while ((delta << 1) <= biggest) delta <<= 1;
            for (; delta > 0; delta >>= 1) {
                while (true) {
                    int[] parentNode = new int[N];
                    int[] parentEdge = new int[N];
                    if (!bfs(s, t, delta, parentNode, parentEdge)) break;
                    int aug = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                    for (int v = t; v != s; v = parentNode[v]) {
                        aug = Math.min(aug, g.get(parentNode[v]).get(parentEdge[v]).cap);
                    }
                    for (int v = t; v != s; v = parentNode[v]) {
                        Edge e = g.get(parentNode[v]).get(parentEdge[v]);
                        e.cap -= aug;
                        g.get(v).get(e.rev).cap += aug;
                    }
                    total += aug;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        // Initialize floorplan
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                floorplan[i][j] = new Room();
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                floorplan[i][j].i = i;
                floorplan[i][j].j = j;
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    floorplan[i][j].setReactor();
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].setInfected(0);
                } else {
                    floorplan[i][j].scientists = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch != 'Y' && ch != 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].capsules = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // Spread infection
        for (int c = 0; c < t; c++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    floorplan[i][j].spreadInfection(c);
                }
            }
        }

        ScalingMaxFlow mf = new ScalingMaxFlow(n * n * (t + 1) + 2);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Room room = floorplan[i][j];
                if (room.scientists > 0) {
                    mf.addEdge(0, room.getNodeId(0), room.scientists);
                }
                if (room.capsules > 0) {
                    mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(t), 1, room.capsules);
                }
                for (int c = 0; c < t; c++) {
                    if (room.capsules > 0) {
                        mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), room.getNodeId(t), 1000);
                    }
                    if (room.accessible[c]) {
                        if (i > 0 && floorplan[i - 1][j].accessible[c]) {
                            mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i - 1][j].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (i < n - 1 && floorplan[i + 1][j].accessible[c]) {
                            mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i + 1][j].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j > 0 && floorplan[i][j - 1].accessible[c]) {
                            mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i][j - 1].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j < n - 1 && floorplan[i][j + 1].accessible[c]) {
                            mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i][j + 1].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(mf.maxFlow(0, 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
